summary: The desktop deliverable, trust split, and gating are appropriate, but the active plan still contains AC-8-only prohibitions that conflict with the desktop shell, dependency, lockfile and Nx topology work.

open_findings.title: Scope the completed AC-8 restrictions to their historical increment
open_findings.description: The plan calls runtime-info work the current increment and prohibits dependency, lockfile and workspace topology changes, while the desktop sequence requires Electron/Forge, a desktop-shell project and a packaged app.
open_findings.requested_change: Mark AC-8 as completed historical evidence, confine its no-live-runtime and no-dependency-change rules to that probe, and explicitly permit reviewed desktop manifests, lockfile and project-topology changes after product/design review. Mark new desktop checks as planned targets that do not exist until the reviewed bootstrap creates them.
open_findings.validation_expectation: A fresh implementer can determine from the plan when desktop dependencies/topology may change and which synthetic effects are permitted, without contradictory current-increment prohibitions.

provenance.review_mode: Fresh independent read-only plan and contract review
